title: Generalized stack-sorting：Conjecture 4.4 的首个未验证枚举关系
summary: The requested first unverified relation n=7 is an exact certified finite theorem: |M_13|=47,265,120, |M_14|=378,120,960=8|M_13|, and deleting the last entry and standardizing is eight-to-one. Two discovery enumerators, a portable no-import full verifier, structured negative tests, a 362,879-case factorization attack, primary-source citation audit, post-result novelty search, clean LaTeX build, five-page visual inspection, source-ZIP rebuild, and inner/outer manifests all pass. This does not prove Conjecture 4.4 for all n.
